scenicChapters.title: Buciumi - Coasta Ogrăzii 1 → Hurez - Cornul Vlașinului 1 & 2
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 17 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-buciumi-coasta-ograzii-1-romanasi.story: A 102 km round trip from Stârciu - roughly 1 h 46 in the saddle. It goes by way of Hurez - Cornul Vlașinului 1 & 2, Românași - Largiana / Cetate and back through Hurez - Cornul Vlașinului 1 & 2. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.
